hook_text: A red ribbon from Polokwane, five thousand kilometres north, to one of the greatest societies in history.
clip_script: Polokwane, Limpopo. A red ribbon stretches across a map of Africa: Zimbabwe, Zambia, Tanzania, Uganda, South Sudan, Sudan, all the way to Cairo. There, along the Nile, about five thousand years ago, an African civilisation was born: ancient Egypt. It lasted about three thousand years. Pyramids, temples, hieroglyphic writing, mathematics and medicine. And because the desert is so dry, so much of it survives for us to study today.
visual_style: Whiteboard map of Africa with a ribbon drawn north, then pyramids, hieroglyphs and a golden mask appearing around the Nile.
mood: Awe-filled and proud, like setting out on a great journey.
pacing: A long journey north, then a burst of discoveries.
